description: Source code implementing encryption, decryption, and directory creation functions for forward lock DRM in Android, utilizing OpenSSL AES and file system operations.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_CreateDirectories
methods.description: Creates all directories along a given path with specified permissions.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_InitializeRoundKeys
methods.description: Initializes AES round keys for encryption and decryption using a device-unique key.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_ValidatePadding
methods.description: Validates padding of decrypted AES data.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_GetRandomNumber
methods.description: Generates cryptographically secure random bytes from /dev/urandom.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_InitializeKeyEncryption
methods.description: Initializes key encryption setup, ensuring round keys are ready.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_GetEncryptedKeyLength
methods.description: Calculates encrypted key length based on plaintext size.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_EncryptKey
methods.description: Encrypts a plaintext key using AES CBC with a random IV.

methods.name: FwdLockGlue_DecryptKey
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted key using AES CBC and validates padding.
